plan.summary: Implement robustness fixes in trace_reader.py and trace_metrics.py to handle malformed optional fields as identified in test_robustness.py. Validate every optional container and primitive type per BRIEF before access. Handle non-dict response, invalid usage_metadata/response_metadata, non-list tool_calls, and non-list/non-dict tests. Ensure invalid role becomes unknown, invalid attempt becomes 1, only integer nonzero exit_code means failure, and proper token fallback with zero precedence.
